items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: but I think Thompson had about the best band at that time

ctx.x: A round cylinder? Yeah, it was a round. What's it called a cylinder? Yeah, a round racket. Yeah. It wasn't a flat one. It wasn't like this. It was a cup, they call them also.

Yeah, it was round. It wasn't a flat one like they make these days. It was round ones. But it was a good record because I think my daddy had it quite a while and we played it a lot. And when he wasn't there, we was playing it a lot. We had about 10 or 15 records round there. We'd, you know what I mean, just pick them up and play them any of them. Mm-hmm. And, but I think Thompson had about the best band at that time, so we just, just keep playing over and over and over. And just jumping, dancing, hollering, and…
Yeah, that's huh. Grammophones is another name, do I get. Orthophonics they used to call them.
